fusions.name: Shed-Tail Lash
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Spins your tail in a full circle, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Noonday Bolt
fusions.desc: After a 1 second cast, looses a bolt of stored sunlight that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its resistances.

fusions.name: Regrown in Turn
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Turning Toward Noon
fusions.desc: During the day, your damage rises by 12%.
